target_bug_relation: The protected UI-state test navigates to the multiScene typical-scene page and reads the bounds of the navigation header title and subtitle through UiTest. On the pre-fix revision the custom title builder is configured without an explicit height, so the header texts are laid out lower (title top 174, subtitle bottom 226) and intrude into the content band; on the post-fix revision the title area declares height 80 and the header stays in the top band (title top 121, subtitle bottom 178). The test asserts the header position against deterministic pixel limits; it contains no wall-clock assertions. The unrelated directory-navigation texts are resolved from the application resources so the trigger follows the real user path (typical scene list -> multiScene page).
